The challenge is distinguishing between genuine self-expression and performing charm to get what you want.
PLCMT_VENUS_HOUSE1.behavioral: You attract easily, charm naturally, and need to be appreciated for your immediate presence. When you walk into a room, people notice you as attractive or appealing.
